Name: ( Daisy's Redux ) Shane Edition
Author: sunsetfarm
Description:
[center][size=5]﻿[font=Verdana]Daisy's Redux : Shane Edition!
[/font][/size][font=Verdana]A Portrait Mod by Sunsetfarm
V. 1.0

[b]WHAT DOES THIS MOD DO?[/b]
It redesigns Shane's vanilla portraits and character sprites to make them look a bit more spruced up.
This redesign is based off of my headcanon that Marnie's family is Latinx,
matching with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3683]my Jas mod[/url]﻿.

[b]HOW TO INSTALL :[/b]
❧ Download and unzip file
❧ Backup the [b]original Shane.xnb[/b] and [b]Shane_JojaMart.xnb[/b] files in both the [b]Characters[/b] and [b]Portraits[/b] folders,
along with the [b]original Cursors.xnb[/b] in the [b]LooseSprites[/b] folder
❧ Copy and Paste the modded files into those folders
❧ Allow the modded files to replace the originals
❧ Run your game and enjoy!


[u]If you have any questions about the mod, please feel free to ask!


[/u][b]FUTURE PLANS :[/b]

( made to be compatible with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2569]Befriend Marlon and Gunther mod[/url]﻿ )
❧ New NPCs*
